name: eBay used graphics-card market (GeForce RTX 4090 as reference used accelerator)
price_basis: USED / Pre-Owned, bare PCIe graphics card, no server, as-is, no warranty stated. $2,000.00 is the ASUS TUF Gaming RTX 4090 24GB listing = LOW end of genuine used 4090s in the captured result set; genuine used 4090s ran $2,000-$3,000 with the bulk at $2,500-$3,000 (MSI GAMING X TRIO $2,999.00, ASUS ROG Strix OC $3,000.00, Zotac Trinity OC $2,999.00). Captured 2026-10-03 from eBay.com used-only search _sacat=27386, 60/page. These are ASKING prices on live listings, not completed sales.
notes: Most liquid, best-documented used accelerator channel in this slice: ~50 genuine used consumer cards on one used-filtered page, brand facets ASUS 292 / MSI 254 / NVIDIA 250 / EVGA 192 / GIGABYTE 192 / ZOTAC 122 / PNY 42. Price buckets: under $1,400 / $1,400-$2,800 / over $2,800. RISK - TITLE-POLLUTION TRAP observed directly in the data: the cheapest '4090' listings are not 4090s. They are (a) cooling hardware with NO GPU - MSI SUPRIM LIQUID X heatsink+watercooler+PCB at $239.99, ASUS ROG Strix LC enclosure+cooler only at $399.95, ASUS LC water cooler $289.99, Manli RTX4090 PCIe adapter $319-$435; and (b) WRONG-VRAM SKUs - 'ASUS ROG XG Mobile eGPU Dock RTX 4090 16GB GDDR6' at $1,499.99 and $1,999.99, which is a 16GB laptop die, not the 24GB desktop part. Any tool taking 'cheapest used 4090' without parsing titles returns a heatsink. Other risk: used consumer cards carry no transferable NVIDIA warranty, no NVLink, no ECC, and are consumer dies - not a substitute for A100/H100 in a memory-capacity-bound serving role. Spare-parts prices observed in the same set (what a refurb house cannibalises, not what you deploy): A100 40G/80G heatsink only $199.00, H100 SXM5 4-GPU NVLink backplane $1,800.00, V100 SXM2 16GB module $65.00, V100 32GB SXM3 tested $425.00.
